# Sensitivity: unit of the tradition random intercept (generated by analysis/make_numbers.py)

Main set: condition C, k = 10, T3 exclusions and low_control removed. Mixed model pull_C_k10 ~ 1 + (1|tradition), REML; one-sided Wald z; Holm across the 3 models; supported if p_holm < .05.

Groupings: raw labels = the labels in data/blind_items.csv (the main analysis in t1_results.json uses these); strong candidates merged = data/tradition_harmonisation.csv; all weak merged = results/harmonisation_all_weak_merged.csv.

**Verdict changes against the raw-label grouping: none.**
